svg.title: Fortress Core layered architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture for Apache Fortress Core: public API managers, implementation layer, policy/processor/utility layer, DAO layer, and LDAP persistence layer. Requests flow top-down; no lower layer imports from an upper layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who calls the Fortress Core public API?')

g.text: Caller-facing interfaces — no persistence or policy logic resides here
